title: LibWeb: Prevent crash in content calculations for ListItemMarkerBox
task_prompt: Fix the crash triggered by Tests/LibWeb/Text/input/wpt-import/css/css-pseudo/parsing/marker-supported-properties-in-animation.html. Loading that page crashes inside FormattingContext when computing the specified content size of a ListItemMarkerBox — a pointer is dereferenced without a null check in a path that can be reached with certain CSS pseudo-element animation declarations. The page should load and produce the expected text output in Tests/LibWeb/Text/expected/wpt-import/css/css-pseudo/parsing/marker-supported-properties-in-animation.txt.
